toolsPreview.name: agent_board_post
toolsPreview.description: Post an encrypted agent-to-agent request, response, or notice. Requires a configured free agent-board key.

toolsPreview.name: agent_board_inbox
toolsPreview.description: Read encrypted messages addressed to this configured agent.

toolsPreview.name: agent_board_ack
toolsPreview.description: Mark a message addressed to this agent as acknowledged.

toolsPreview.name: agent_board_reply
toolsPreview.description: Reply to a visible encrypted agent-board message.

toolsPreview.name: design
toolsPreview.description: Generate a profile-aware AI data center design basis from IT load, rack density, GPU generation, site area, region, and optional project inputs.

toolsPreview.name: validate
toolsPreview.description: Validate a previous design summary or raw design input against electrical, cooling, layout, safety, and data rules. Private EngineSessions are not exposed through public MCP.

toolsPreview.name: layout
toolsPreview.description: Generate profile-aware physical rack blocks, rack-plan candidates, and site layout data from a nested design request.
